text:
Nina (growth): Quick thread Station Wharf pop-up next Wed eve. Need final micro-checklist and lead flow. Key: 1) tabletop poster, 2) 100 stickers, 40 tees, 200 cards, 3) 12m lightning + 8m Q, 4) webinar prefill QR + tagging. Who can own?
Ethan (events): I'll own load-in and volunteers. Room opens 17:30, talk 19:00. Need HDMI, extension, tape, and two chairs. Volunteers: @Maya 17:15-19:15, @Sam 19:00-21:00.
Priya (ops): Swag counts in staging: 95 stickers, 38 tees, 190 cards. Courier pickup Tue 10:00. Badge CSV header: name,email,company,utm_campaign,source,interest_tag. Use utm_campaign=station_wharf.
Leo (design): I'll finalize poster and 1-pager today. Headline idea: "Reliable LLM inference for real apps." Benchmark blurb proposed: "~30% lower token cost in production traces" —keep conservative?
Nina (growth): Good. Use softer language: "~30% lower token cost in production traces (varies by workload)". Webinar flow: immediate opt-in checkbox -> list station_followup; Day0 invite, Day3 reminder, Day7 recording + dataset. Tag leads interest:dedicated/interest:private.
Zoe (sales): Sales asks: add "sq_priority" (low/med/high) and "enterprise_flag". We'll triage within 48h. If onsite asks for private on-prem, mark high.
Ethan (events): I'll bring a cable lock and clipboard. Can someone confirm Square reader?
Priya (ops): We have Square + backup. QR QA: @Sam can test tonight. I'll run export after event: export-leads --campaign station_wharf --out station_leads.csv
Leo (design): Figma: https://figma.com/file/stationwharf/leo-assets. Promo code STWH10 for tracking. Leave 0.5in bleed for prints.
Nina (growth): Final owners: volunteers/load-in (Ethan), shipping & badges (Priya), assets & prints (Leo), lead flow/webinar (Nina). I'll post webinar invite copy tomorrow AM. :rocket: 
DispatchBot: Courier pickup scheduled Tue 10:00. Reminder to #events at Tue 09:30.
Sam: I'll test QR tonight and bring Square reader.
Maya: I'll run AM setup and check poster placement.
Nina (growth): Thanks everyone. If anything changes ping here.
